title: Maximum Element
description:
You have an empty sequence, and you will be given N queries. Each query is one of these three types:

1 x -Push the element x into the stack.
2 -Delete the element present at the top of the stack.
3 -Print the maximum element in the stack.
input_format: The first line of input contains an integer, n. The next n lines each contain an above mentioned query.
output_format: For each type 3 query, print the maximum element currently in the stack on a new line.
